jobs.prompt: The new end-to-end test in tests/board-owner-routes.test.mjs 'production remote board lists inbox decisions through ownerItemsFromBoardInbox and enforces board-safe rules' fails deterministically on this machine (Node 20): `prepare safe-accent` returns 404 instead of 200, i.e. the decision is NOT found by the production listItems (tools/watch-cli.mjs ~line 531) even though it is in the project journal. The failure output is in the evidence block. Keep the refusals (unmarked, long-text merge) refused. Run `node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test --test-timeout=60000 tests/board-owner-routes.test.mjs tests/board-inbox.test.mjs tests/board-owner-actions-handlers.test.mjs` and report the pass count.
